C: › a solid or hollow tube with long straight sides and two circular ends the same size, or an object shaped like this, often used as a container
圓柱體；圓柱狀物；圓筒（常用作容器）
› the tube-shaped device, found especially in an engine, inside which the part of the engine that causes the fuel to produce power moves up and down

example: Deep-sea divers carry cylinders of oxygen on their backs.
深海潛水員背上背有氧氣筒。

NONE: › having the shape of a cylinder (= hollow tube)
